source_doc.title: POET Technologies Provides Purchase Order Update — Marvell cancels all Celestial AI purchase orders (POET SEC Form 6-K Exhibit 99.1, April 27, 2026)
source_doc.permission_basis: Official SEC EDGAR primary filing (POET Technologies Form 6-K, Exhibit 99.1), public domain government-hosted disclosure. Repository retains attributed extraction and canonical SEC URL.

sources.quote: today announced the cancellation of all purchase orders received by the Company from Celestial AI, including the ones for initial production units first disclosed (the "Purchase Orders") by the Company in a press release on April 25, 2023
Marvell Semiconductor Inc., which acquired Celestial AI, provided written notice of the cancellation to the Company on April 23, 2026
Marvell indicated that the Company had made disclosures of information related to the Purchase Order and shipping information in contravention of its confidentiality obligations

claims.statement: Marvell Semiconductor (which acquired Celestial AI) cancelled all of POET Technologies' Celestial AI purchase orders — written notice given 2026-04-23, POET announced 2026-04-27 — citing alleged POET breach of confidentiality obligations. This terminates the POET→Celestial optical-engine supply channel and, by extension, cuts Sivers' indirect route to Celestial/Marvell AI demand via POET (Sivers→POET→Celestial).
claims.disproof_condition: Revise if POET and Marvell/Celestial reinstate the purchase orders or announce a replacement supply agreement.
